name: 牧草产量估算（亩产×面积）

map.📐 牧草产量估算（亩产×面积）: 📐 Forage Yield Estimator (Yield per Mu x Area)
map.输入亩产鲜草量、种植面积与干物质率，自动估算鲜草、干草总产量及干草捆数。: Enter fresh-grass yield per mu, planting area, and dry-matter rate to auto-estimate total fresh and dry grass and the number of bales.
map.📖 查看「牧草产量估算（亩产×面积）使用指南」: 📖 View the "Forage Yield Estimator (Yield per Mu x Area) Guide"
map.鲜草总量 = 亩产 × 面积 × 单位系数；干草产量 = 鲜草总量 × 干物质率: Total fresh grass = yield/mu x area x unit factor; dry grass = total fresh x dry-matter%; bales = dry grass / bale weight
map.单位系数把亩产换算为总量（kg/亩 直乘、t/ha × 0.0001、kg/㎡: The unit factor converts yield/mu into total (kg/mu direct, t/ha x 0.0001, kg/m2 direct by area). Total fresh times dry-matter rate gives air-dried grass; divided by bale weight gives bale count, with converted mu and hectare figures, for forage yield estimation and baling plans.
map.💡 公式：鲜草总产量 = 亩产 × 面积（按单位换算）；干草产量 = 鲜草产量: 💡 Formula: total fresh grass = yield/mu x area (by unit conversion); dry grass = fresh yield x dry-matter rate; bale count = dry grass / bale weight.
map.亩产单位选择“吨/公顷”或“kg/㎡”时，面积仍按平方米输入，工具会自动换算。: When yield unit is "ton/hectare" or "kg/m2", area is still entered in square meters and the tool auto-converts.
map.干物质率因牧草种类、刈割时期与晾晒程度差异较大，默认值 30% 仅供参考。: Dry-matter rate varies widely by forage type, cutting time, and drying; the default 30% is for reference only.
map.干草捆数按小方捆 25 kg 估算，大型圆捆或青贮包请自行调整单捆重量。: Bale count assumes 25 kg small square bales; adjust bale weight for large round bales or silage packs.
map.📚 深度解析：牧草产量估算（亩产×面积）: 📚 Deep Dive: Forage Yield Estimator (Yield per Mu x Area)
map.总产量 = 测产亩产 × 面积 × 刈割次数系数。: Total output = measured yield/mu x area x cutting-count factor.
map.按鲜草或干草分别计量。: Measure fresh or dry grass separately.
map.用于草畜平衡与青贮计划。: Used for grass-livestock balance and silage planning.
map.测产鲜草亩产 1500 kg，面积 30 亩，年刈 4 茬，则鲜草总产 = 15: Measured fresh yield 1500 kg/mu, area 30 mu, 4 cuts/year: total fresh = 1500 x 30 x 4 = 180,000 kg = 180 t. As dry grass (water 20% vs fresh 70%) about 60 t.
map.鲜草和干草产量差这么多？: Why do fresh and dry yields differ so much?
map.鲜草含水 60%~80%，干草 15%~20%，『干物质』才是可比基数。交易与饲: Fresh grass is 60%~80% water, dry 15%~20%; "dry matter" is the comparable base. Trade and feed formulas should use dry matter to avoid water misleading.
map.看积温与降水，一般 3~5 茬。过度刈割伤根、降翌年产量，应在初花期前刈以兼顾产: Depends on accumulated temperature and rainfall, generally 3~5 cuts. Over-cutting harms roots and lowers next-year yield; cut before first bloom to balance yield and quality.
